Container.Name: cloudcli
Container.Overview: Claude Code on the Unraid host: CloudCLI web UI (chat, terminal, files, git) plus a Claude Code Remote Control server for claude.ai/code and the Claude mobile app. Privileged, shares the host PID namespace and mounts the host root at /host: full root access to the server. LAN only, do not expose.
Container.Requires: A Claude Pro or Max subscription.

Config.Name: Home
Config.Description: Claude login, sessions, CloudCLI database and the Claude CLI itself. Use a pool path (/mnt/cache/...), not /mnt/user: SQLite.

Config.Name: JWT_SECRET
Config.Description: Long random string signing CloudCLI logins

Config.Name: WORKSPACES_ROOT
Config.Description: Projects must live under this path

Config.Name: RC_DIR
Config.Description: Working directory of Remote Control sessions
